output.review_comment: The PR lacks a description and test confirmation. More critically, the rounding logic appears reverse-engineered from specific test cases rather than implementing a clearly documented spec. The special-case behavior for values in [1.0, 2.0) with the comment "avoid underdisplaying" indicates test-specific logic. Before merging, provide: (1) a PR description confirming tests pass, (2) documentation of the rounding spec, (3) verification of edge cases like unit cascading after rounding.
